result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: it is mutual, applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services, lasts 12 months from the end of each individual's involvement, includes general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and does not prohibit hiring. Unrelated commercial language in Section 12.3 is preserved. Drafting is professional, though the final reference to an individual who “approaches the other party” is slightly ambiguous; the preceding express carve-out for unsolicited approaches nevertheless makes the intended exception operative.
